title: Conditional coefficient compatibility for finite-cover extension by zero
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] separated finite-type curve of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. Let $j:U\to X$ be an open immersion, $r$ prime, $R=\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf Z/r\mathbf Z)$, and $G$ a finite locally constant $R$-module sheaf on $U$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Let $v:V\to U$ be finite etale. Put $F=j_!G$ and $K=j_!(v_*v^*G)$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Then $K$ is constructible [def-constructible-constructible]; if $F$ has torsion of invertible order over $\operatorname{Spec}k$, so does $K$; and for every prime $p$ with $\operatorname{char}k=p$, if $F$ is $p$-primary then $K$ is $p$-primary [def-weil-pbc-primary-torsion]. No retraction or cohomology hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03SD, lemma-vanishing-easier, first paragraph (coefficient check implicit in descent to a summand); Tag 095R, lemma-finite-pushforward-constructible, and its finite etale case lemma-pushforward-constructible.

proof.text: Pullback preserves finite local constancy and finite etale lower-star preserves it. Finite local constancy gives constructibility on the open by the trivial stratification; extension by zero across the closed complement preserves constructibility.

For coefficients over ULift(ZMod r), r annihilates every stalk element by the ZMod characteristic. If an invertible-order or p-primary hypothesis on F permits a nonzero stalk element, divisibility of its annihilator by r follows from the ZMod scalar action. If p differs from r, this contradicts primality; if an annihilator is invertible, r is invertible by IsUnit.mul_iff. Otherwise all stalks vanish and conservativity gives F=0; full faithfulness of extension by zero and functorial preservation of zero make K=0.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoverLowerShriek_coefficient_compatibility {k : Type u}
    [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X U V : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime]
    (G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))))
    [Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G] (v : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite v] [Etale v] :
    let R := ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)
    let F := (Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) j).obj G
    let K := (Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) j).obj
      ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) v).obj
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) v).obj G))
    Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf K ∧
      (Scheme.IsTorsionSheafOfInvertibleOrder (Spec (.of k)) F →
        Scheme.IsTorsionSheafOfInvertibleOrder (Spec (.of k)) K) ∧
      (∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p],
        Scheme.IsPrimaryTorsionSheaf R F p → Scheme.IsPrimaryTorsionSheaf R K p)
